arguments.message: Hi there – If you received an email asking you to wire money, it’s likely not a legitimate Meridian request. Meridian never asks customers to wire funds via email and only accepts payments through the methods set in your account’s Billing settings. Please do not reply, click any links, or make a payment. Instead, compare the invoice details with what you see in Settings → Billing, and forward the suspicious email to our support team so we can verify it against your actual billing record.
